commands.command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0750 /etc/nginx/tls8443
cat > /usr/local/sbin/rotate-8443-certificate <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
cert_dir=/etc/nginx/tls8443
cert="$cert_dir/server.crt"
key="$cert_dir/server.key"
renew_before=604800
if [ "${1:-}" != "--force" ] && [ -s "$cert" ] && [ -s "$key" ] && openssl x509 -checkend "$renew_before" -noout -in "$cert" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf 'certificate still valid beyond renewal window: '
    openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -serial -enddate
    exit 0
fi
host_name=$(hostname -s)
node_ip=$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')
tmp_dir=$(mktemp -d "$cert_dir/.renew.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp_dir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -sha256 -nodes -days 30 \
    -subj "/CN=$host_name" \
    -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:$host_name,IP:$node_ip" \
    -keyout "$tmp_dir/server.key" -out "$tmp_dir/server.crt" >/dev/null 2>&1
chmod 0600 "$tmp_dir/server.key"
chmod 0644 "$tmp_dir/server.crt"
chown root:root "$tmp_dir/server.key" "$tmp_dir/server.crt"
mv -f "$tmp_dir/server.key" "$key"
mv -f "$tmp_dir/server.crt" "$cert"
if systemctl is-active --quiet nginx; then
    nginx -t
    systemctl reload nginx
fi
printf 'installed certificate: '
openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -serial -startdate -enddate
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0750 /usr/local/sbin/rotate-8443-certificate
/usr/local/sbin/rotate-8443-certificate --force
openssl x509 -in /etc/nginx/tls8443/server.crt -noout -subject -issuer -serial -dates -ext subjectAltName

[Unit]

[Timer]

RandomizedDelaySec=1h
Persistent=true
Unit=cert-rotate-8443.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

fail_count=$(grep -c '^fail$' "$results" || true)
